description: This file defines the SocketConnectionListener class, which implements a network connection listener using sockets for the Orleans framework. It manages socket binding, accepting incoming connections, and cleanup.

classes.name: SocketConnectionListener
classes.description: Implements a socket-based connection listener for Orleans, handling socket binding, accepting connections, and cleanup.

methods.name: SocketConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with endpoint, options, trace, and schedulers.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to the specified endpoint, setting socket options and preparing it to accept connections.

methods.name: AcceptAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously accepts incoming socket connections and creates a SocketConnection object.

methods.name: UnbindAsync
methods.description: Disposes the listening socket, unbinding the listener.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes the socket and memory pool resources asynchronously.
